LESSON: READING FOR COMMUNICATION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Reading 2.6 Skimming for information (2 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, 
Topic 2.7: Reading for Communication
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Communication, part of Reading 2.6 Skimming for information (2 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand,  in Grade 9 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: How can reading enhance knowledge? 35 mir weh; Wo hast du Schmerzen?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search (from different sources) and read out with peers

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Communication together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: the learner develops the ability to articulate their problems as they interact with peers on the kind of illnesses

they suffer from.

Values:
Love: the learner demonstrates the value of compassion when s/he discusses with peers what kind of illnesses their peers

suffer from.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Lifestyle Diseases: the learner develops an awareness of lifestyle diseases when s/he discusses with peers the kind of illnesses

their peers suffer from.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the content on types and remedies of illnesses with content learned in Integrated Science.
